content:
I’d like to report a small bug related to module deprecation.

A squiggly underline appears on an import statement, but it seems to be applied to the first import statement in the file rather than to the import statement for the deprecated module.

Hi @Asei Inoue - thank you for reporting the issue. I have just made a PR (lean4#14564) that fixes this. Basically, deprecated module warnings were previously attached to the first command of the file, but the PR I have linked correctly looks at header information to get the right syntax ref.
